why_needed: The successful NEG_TECH_2 nuisance is close to the frozen ridge basis because it is geometry-scaled by degree and inverse distance. This successor tests model misspecification without changing the estimator after seeing the outcome.

single_new_negative.name: NEG_TECH_OUTSPAN_1
single_new_negative.construction: Use the same hidden-quality latent hq as NEG_TECH_2, but multiply the ATAC-side loading by a smooth non-monotonic geometry function outside the frozen 14-feature ridge span.
constraints: no target labels or linked status enter g
effect amplitude remains 0.60 on RNA and ATAC
measured-depth and hidden-quality mixing remains unchanged from NEG_TECH_2
all existing worlds, seeds, positives and nuisance families remain unchanged

estimator.must_remain_unchanged: V63 continuous-adjustment primary estimator at c4e78de2
forbidden: choosing a new nuisance function after seeing the result

qualification.same_rule: Every represented nuisance family, now including OUTSPAN_TECH, must have one-sided LCB95 > M_MIN=0.010.

interpretation.A_outspan_passes: Evidence of generalisation beyond exact nuisance-model specification within this frozen misspecification class.
interpretation.B_outspan_fails_only: Estimator is qualified only for nuisance surfaces within or near its frozen model span. Do not generalise to arbitrary hidden-quality geometry.
interpretation.D_support_concentrates: Treat as disguised support failure, not a pass.

scope: Empirical misspecification stress, not theorem-level identifiability.
